# PART 4 – Multiverse and preregistration {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 4

::: notes
At the end of Part 3 you tried specifications and watched the estimate move. This part gives that activity its name, reads it as a chart, and then takes up the question that it raises and does not answer, which of all those defensible analyses one should publish. The question has a serious literature and a live argument behind it, on which you will be able to take a position by the end of the part. You then settle on one analysis, preregister it before you run it, and submit it to the class chart.
:::
